metadata.title: Conversation with Jason Wang: Educator in the AI Era, a Decade of Ups and Downs, and Humanity's Next Step
metadata.guest_role: Tanyue School founder · PKU High / Principal Wang Zheng lineage · Innovative education practitioner

conclusion: Tanyue founder Jason Wang talks with SV101 for 4.5 hours: at 18 in 2015 he predicted AI would replace a third of procedural jobs and chose to build a school; a decade spanning PKU High incubation, hotel openings, and ~500 students. He frames K-12 as society's simulator — factories in the industrial era, real projects and portfolio credentials in the AI era. Palantir, Anthropic, and OpenAI scout super high schoolers; M48 runs AI-for-Good nationally. Core philosophy: cultivate internally abundant citizens; perceiving love is trainable; civilization risk is material-spiritual imbalance. Wang regrets arrogance — hand-craft the first chip before the factory.
background:
EP188 follows EP187's campus visit with a long conversation on entrepreneurship, philosophy, and civilization. Opens on Wang's 2015 essay before AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol, before Transformers, seven years before ChatGPT — already arguing one-third of jobs disappear and the bottleneck is education.

Personal arc: Mianyang boarding school → PKU High under Principal Wang Zheng (free scheduling, one-third self-study, Plato, CAS internships) → St. John's College professors' Socratic humanities → Tanyue incubated 2018 at PKU High. Wife collateralized home for 2020 loans; 2021–2022 debt and regulatory crisis nearly broke him until 'perceiving love' practice; now a father telling son 'Lemon' to grow a vigorous, loving soul.
important_facts: Ten-year swings and governance: 2017–2018 PKU High incubation; mission to cultivate internally abundant individuals and active citizens to sustain civilization; 2019 big campus bet → pandemic delay → 2020 hotel opening ('Where do you start school? In a hotel'), three moves; 2021 'double reduction' ended full-time training-license path, later Tennis Center site. Wang rejected multiple private-school deals — feared partners would deprioritize education in downturns; personal liability debt, wife as guarantor. Reflects mission drew from Great Learning 'roots before branches' yet skipped self-cultivation; early 'puffed arrogance' created regulatory risk; ~500 students 'just right'; ideal is sharing, not national factory scale.

Education first principles: diploma's first job = low cognitive-cost consensus plus platform resource access; in the AI era employers may skip university certification when high-school portfolios prove value to end users. School = society simulator — next civilization's work/learn/solitude scenes should be rehearsed; within 5–10 years much university certification sinks to K-12 portfolios. St. John's style = edu (draw out what's already there); Tanyue competency transcripts link to artifact evidence. M48 hackathon dual goals: validate 'One Small Step' (post-high-school AI entrepreneurship) plus social cognition shift; AI-for-Good themes, national high-schoolers, travel covered. Chen Guangyu and other non-enrolled alumni become age-agnostic tech influencers.

Civilization and perceiving love: Wang worries material civilization (AI self-destruction capacity) outruns spiritual civilization (love, happiness training) — Fermi-paradox filter risk. Ultimate pursuit is happiness, rarely practiced as a skill; internal abundance = perceiving love plus giving love (inward, not grasping). Jobs reportedly wanted all his technology for one afternoon with Socrates. Graduate paths diverge: Harvard/MIT/liberal arts, German art, 15-year-old new species discovery then insect-tech startup, Silicon Valley founder asked partner 'how do I hire this kid.' Palantir/Anthropic/OpenAI no longer fixate on Stanford alone — scouting downstream super talent.

mental_model.name: Society Simulator × Hand-Craft Chip × Perceiving-Love Competency × Dual Civilization
mental_model.components: Treat K-12 as a holographic simulator of the next civilization stage, not a factory line; cultivate self (perceiving love, happiness skill) before 'ordering the world' (mission). Diplomas → portfolio credentials cut certification cost; when AI flattens engineering, aesthetics/judgment/emotional nuance decide 3.0 vs 9.5 quality. Material and spiritual tracks must balance — technology without love self-destructs; educators are soul engineers (felt unity with all things).
mental_model.application: Long/Low Private:Tanyue School — trust asset that doesn't scale, but exports super-teen signals. PLTR/Anthropic/OpenAI (Long/Low) front-run high-school talent wars; GOOGL (Long/Low) AI tools lower hackathon and 'One Small Step' barriers, accelerating Wang's 'timing opportunity' thesis. No direct civilization ticker — watch competency rails replacing diplomas; beware treating innovative schools as consumer brands instead of ten-year hand-crafted chips.

key_insights.view: Schools simulate the next civilization stage.
key_insights.question: Does the factory model still work?
key_insights.answer: Post-industrial schools copied factory hours and division of labor; the AI era should simulate projects, creation, and end-to-end value flow. University research enclaves (Princeton IAS-like) stay irreplaceable, but much certification sinks to K-12 portfolios within 5–10 years.

key_insights.view: Perceiving love is a trainable core competency.
key_insights.question: What anchors internal abundance?
key_insights.answer: Happiness should be practiced like a skill; perceiving love looks inward (birdsong, trees, daily gifts), not outward grasping. Wang lost this in 2021–2022 debt crisis; recovery aligned mission and parenting — soul engineering maintains unity-with-all-things.

key_insights.view: Hand-craft the chip before the factory.
key_insights.question: Biggest ten-year lesson?
key_insights.answer: Education accrues trust cohort-by-cohort like media or semiconductors — not internet viral replication. Early oversized mission without self-cultivation; big campus + training license + pandemic + double reduction chain reaction. Rejected mergers knowing cycle volatility sacrifices mission; 500 students is the responsible ceiling.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Ten-year hand-crafted competency chip — society-simulator theory, M48 hackathon, portfolio credentials; ~500 healthy scale, graduates tracked by VCs and top founders. High trust barrier, regulatory and debt scars, hard to securitize; Long on talent/culture signal not revenue multiples

With Anthropic/OpenAI, scouts high-school super talent downstream — second-year Tanyue student now Silicon Valley founder queried for hire; PLTR Long on front-loaded high-agency teens, but educational output lags and will not linearly forecast

AI coding/agent tools lower 48-hour hackathon and One Small Step startup barriers — validates Wang timing thesis; GOOGL Gemini/Cursor ecosystem benefits creator economy, though innovative schools are not direct GOOGL revenue drivers
